description:
All electric. Never static. The new Mongoose React E1 Kids Electric Scooter is designed for our youngest riders. This lightweight, ultra-quiet e-scooter tops out at 6 miles per hour and can travel over 7 miles on a single charge. The Mongoose React E1 is sure to be your kid's favorite new set of wheels. Your Ride Electrified.
Rider Profile: Designed for neighborhood cruising for young riders ages 8 and up, with a maximum weight limit of 120 pounds.
Motor and Throttle: Its low-maintenance, ultra-quiet kick start belt drive motor tops out at 6 MPH. To get up to speed, kick start the scooter and use the push button throttle to accelerate.
Battery and Charging: Powered by a long-lasting lead acid battery, the React E1 can travel up to 7. 5 miles on a single charge. Charger included.
Wheels and Brakes: Durable 145 mm urethane wheels offer a stable ride while the rear foot brake disengages the motor to make stopping safe and simple.
Frame and Coasting: The E1's lightweight aluminum frame makes it easy to transport and store and when the battery runs out, it converts into a kick scooter for resistance-free riding to keep the fun going.
